title: Instructions for a Shared Project
instructions: Write your own first draft. After submission, use the feedback to revise incorrect words and grammar.
prompt: Write 100–140 words to a friend who will join a small creative project. Describe the design and materials, say which tools are available and which are missing, explain how to share the work, and give at least three steps in order. Include one polite request and one reason for waiting or being careful. Use your own details.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Plan your message in four parts: purpose; available and missing materials; ordered steps; request and reason. Useful frames: There is some ... / There are ... / We do not have any ... / First ... / After ... / While ... / Please ... because ...
